decisions.reason: Minimum quantity lubrication is adjacent to the firm's core fluid-management know-how and machine-tool customer base, so despite limited post-launch web evidence the firm is likely to retain it and improve it through its modular engineering and service capabilities.

A hydrocyclone coolant filter fits very closely with the firm's established filtration and coolant-treatment competences, giving it strong absorptive capacity to refine and commercialize the product rather than withdraw it.

A gravity band coolant filter is directly within the firm's core filtration platform and installed-base service logic, so an expanding German machinery supplier would usually keep it on the market unless results were clearly poor.
